ITA-3.13.23 kuṭakāsthi, śroṇīkāṇḍam, śroṇikāṇḍāsthi, mayūrāsthi कुटकास्थि, श्रोणिकाण्डम्, श्रोणिकाण्डास्थि, मयूरास्थि
Sacrum, sacrum and coccyx

ITA-3.13.24 śroṇīkarṇaḥ श्रोणीकर्णः
Ala of the sacrum

.1 karṇaḥ, śrotram, śravaṇam कर्णः, श्रोत्रम्, श्रवणम्
Ear

.14 Jñānendriyagatavāta/ śrotrādīndriyagatavātaḥ ज्ञानेन्द्रियगतवात/ श्रोत्रादीन्द्रियगतवातः
Aggravation of vata in the sense organs
A disorder characterized by functional impairment of the sense organs.

ITA-3.10.5 śrotrendriyam श्रोत्रेन्द्रियम्
Auditory sense faculty
One of the sensory faculties : the faculty responsible for perception of sound or hearing.

ITA-2.5.1 srotaḥ स्रोतः
Channel, conduit
Channels for the transportation of substances from one part to another.

ITA-4.8.4 srotoduṣṭiprakāraḥ स्रोतोदुष्टिप्रकारः
Types of body channel deformities
The various types of the deformity affecting the body channels.

ITA-4.8.3 srotoduṣṭihetuḥ स्रोतोदुष्टिहेतुः
Functional alteration of body channels
A structural and/or functional alteration of the body channels due to vitiated dosha or ama.

ITA-4.8.1 srotorodhaḥ स्रोतोरोधः
Obstructive pathology
A complete or partial obstruction in the body channels leading to their malfunctioning.

ITA-5.73.23 srotoviddhaḥ स्रोतोविद्धः
Injury or damage to the body channels

ITA-4.8.2 srotovaiguṇyam स्रोतोवैगुण्यम्
Functional alteration of body channels
A functional and/or structural alteration of the body channels leading to a pathological process.

ITA-5.5.1 srotovaiṣamyam स्रोतोवैषम्यम्
Vitiation of channels
Deleterious changes in the structure and function of channels (srotas) carrying vital life force; water; food; seven tissues; menstrual flow-carrying channel; excretory products: stools, sweat and urine.

ITA-9.5.37 srotoñjana स्रोतोऽञ्जन
Stibnite used as collyrium
A type of collyrium containing antimony sulfide.
